title: Transactions
adjustPeriod: Adjust the period to see the transactions.

empty.filteredDescription: Try another category, type or period.
empty.monthDescription: Add an income or an expense to get started.
empty.periodDescription: Choose another period or add a new transaction.
empty.searchDescription: No description contains “<search/>” with these filters. Try another word or period.

filters.label: Filters
filters.searchPlaceholder: Description, such as groceries or rent

form.amountHint: Always positive: the type defines whether it comes in or goes out.
form.suggestedByRule: Suggested by the “{{pattern}}” rule. You can change it.

recurring.repeatHint: Adds it on day {{day}} from this date on, including past months, through the end of this month; after that, one a month.
recurring.shortMonthHint: In shorter months, on the last day.
recurring.endDateHint: Without a date, it repeats until you stop it.
recurring.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the first date.
recurring.editHint: Changes apply to the next entries; the ones already added don't change.

manager.title: Recurring and installments
manager.note: The ones already added are in Transactions and are edited there, one by one.
manager.empty: No recurring entries. When adding a transaction, check “Repeat every month”.

delete.title: Delete recurring entry
delete.question: Delete <name/>?
delete.note: Nothing else will be added. The transactions already added stay in Transactions.

installments.totalHint: The amount of the whole purchase.
installments.totalTooSmall: The total must be at least R$0.01 per installment.
installments.descriptionHint: Each installment gets its number at the end, like “(3/10)”.
installments.previewFirst: The first one is {{first}}, with the leftover cents.

manager.title: Installment purchases
manager.empty: No installment purchases. When adding an expense, choose “Installments”.

delete.title: Delete installment purchase
delete.question: Delete <name/> ({{total}})?
delete.futureNote: For when you paid it off early: installments up to today stay in Transactions, without the link to the purchase.
delete.allNote: All installments leave Transactions, including past ones. This can't be undone.
